title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 7 sites (L89,L199,L208,L297,L340,L354)
detail: Multiple `except Exception` handlers use `excutils.save_and_reraise_exception()`, which is acceptable OpenStack idiom. A few handlers only log without re-raising. Suggested fix: review non-reraise handlers and narrow the exception type where the specific exceptions from the callee are known.

title: Exception context suppressed: 2 `raise` statements without `from` (L92,L296)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: use `raise NewExc() from exc` or `raise NewExc() from None` if suppression is intentional.
